title: Notch
subtitle: The laptop is the assistant.
closing: Built with Fable 5 in Claude Code.

beats.command: Who are you? Give me a short, confident introduction.
beats.caption: Meet Notch.
beats.narration: Meet Notch — a voice-native assistant that lives in your MacBook's notch, and answers out loud.

beats.command: Change your own voice to a warmer, friendlier ElevenLabs voice — pick a good one, save it to your config, and confirm in your new voice.
beats.caption: Ask it to change itself — it rewrites its own settings.
beats.narration: Ask it to change itself, and it does — here, switching its own voice to something friendlier, on the fly.

beats.command: Open the demobespoke Google Sheet in Safari, read through all of its tabs, find any discrepancies in the data, and email a clear summary of them to romptl8@gmail.com.
beats.caption: Give it real work — across your apps.
beats.narration: Give it something real. It opens your spreadsheet, reads every tab, finds the discrepancies, and emails them — start to finish.

beats.command: Open a meme generator website and create two or three genuinely funny memes grounded in our team's Slack humor. Keep them light and good-natured — nothing offensive to anyone, and never leak any internal or confidential information.
beats.caption: It even has a sense of humor.
beats.narration: It can be playful, too — spinning up a few memes from your team's inside jokes, without ever leaking anything real.

beats.command: Open Persona Chat, have a short conversation with the Mahesh personality, and compare how it responds against his real Slack messages.
beats.caption: It learns the people you work with.
beats.narration: It even learns the people you work with — modeling a teammate's voice, and checking it against how they really talk.

beats.command: Look through my Slack messages with Anirudha, and create a new private Notion document outlining exactly what I need to work on with him.
beats.caption: From a scattered chat to a plan — automatically.
beats.narration: And it turns scattered conversations into action — reading your chats, and writing you a private plan in Notion.
